constitutional_basis: Article XVII — every control must have an attempted bypass. Test fixtures must be HOSTILE — they try to break the controller, not flatter it.

virtual_patient_cohort.purpose: Test controller across diverse physiological scenarios before bench validation.
virtual_patient_cohort.n_patients: 10 simulated, parameterized by Q_production, P_target, occlusion rate, occlusion timing, sensor noise
virtual_patient_cohort.status: SPECIFIED — must be run before bench validation

bench_test_fixtures.purpose: Reproducibly create progressive occlusion in any segment
bench_test_fixtures.method: Computer-controlled stepper motor driving a screw clamp on silicone tubing
bench_test_fixtures.spec: 0-100% occlusion in 256 steps, calibration curve stored in software, repeatability +/- 2%
bench_test_fixtures.commercial_reference: Custom build (~$500) or Festo VEAB-LS proportional valve

bench_test_fixtures.purpose: Realistic CSF production with cardiac-cycle pulsation (not constant flow)
bench_test_fixtures.method: Peristaltic pump + syringe pump with programmable pulse profile (0.5-2 Hz, 10-30% amplitude modulation)
bench_test_fixtures.rationale: Real CSF production is pulsatile. Constant-flow bench test may miss resonance/aliasing issues.

bench_test_fixtures.purpose: Mimic body temperature for viscosity-corrected hydraulic behavior
Mimic protein and cellular content of real CSF (affects viscosity and biofilm formation)
bench_test_fixtures.method: Phosphate-buffered saline + 0.5 g/L bovine serum albumin + trace fibrinogen
bench_test_fixtures.rationale: Pure water has different viscosity and surface tension than CSF. May affect valve behavior.

bench_test_fixtures.purpose: Programmatically disconnect/saturate any sensor to test fail-safe behavior
bench_test_fixtures.method: Software switch in data acquisition pipeline

bench_test_fixtures.purpose: Programmatically freeze any valve at any position

hostile_test_matrix.purpose: Adversarial test combinations designed to break each invariant independently.

tests.name: INV-2 attacker
tests.method: Induce fast lesion on segment 1 (k_occl=10/hr). Controller must isolate before INV-2 violation.
tests.pass_criterion: INV-2 holds throughout. If violated, design must be revised.

tests.name: INV-1 attacker
tests.method: Induce simultaneous mild lesions on ALL 4 segments (k_occl=0.5/hr). Controller cannot isolate all. Must gracefully degrade.
tests.pass_criterion: INV-2 holds. P_ICP peak <= 25 mmHg. System survives 24 hours.

tests.name: Predictor false-positive attacker
tests.method: Inject sensor noise spikes (transient 10x noise) on segment 2. Predictor should NOT isolate based on noise.
tests.pass_criterion: No isolation events triggered by noise. Isolation only on real lesion.

tests.name: Predictor false-negative attacker
tests.method: Slow lesion (k_occl=0.1/hr) — predictor may not fire in 30-min window. Controller must rely on PI feedback.
tests.pass_criterion: P_ICP held below 22 mmHg by PI feedback alone, even if predictor doesn't fire.

tests.name: Communication failure
tests.method: Cut telemetry link at hour 12. Controller must continue operating on local sensors.
tests.pass_criterion: Controller continues dual-invariant operation without external communication.
